name: The War Doctor
oracle_text:
Whenever one or more other permanents phase out and whenever one or more other cards are put into exile from anywhere, put a time counter on The War Doctor.
Whenever The War Doctor attacks, it deals damage equal to the number of time counters on it to any target. If a creature dealt damage this way would die this turn, exile it instead.
blocked_sentences: Whenever one or more other permanents phase out and whenever one or more other cards are put into exile from anywhere, put a time counter on The War Doctor.

needs.what: a batched trigger event that fires when one or more permanents (other than the source) phase out, with the phased-out permanents as the batch
needs.why_existing_wont_do: trigger_events has no phase event; the phase_out op and the phasing keyword exist but nothing emits a triggerable event, and leaves_battlefield is wrong because phasing is not a zone change

needs.what: a batched trigger event that fires when one or more cards (other than the source) are put into exile from any zone -- battlefield, graveyard, hand, library, stack
needs.why_existing_wont_do: leaves_battlefield and leaves_graveyard with to_zones exile cover only one origin zone each; exile from hand, library or the stack (and exiled spells) has no event
